implementation.name: transformers publisher loader on processors behind serve_hy4.py

hardware.description: 2 x Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8276L CPU @ 2.20GHz, 112 threads; 1,971 GiB memory (256 GB DRAM in front of 2 TB Optane persistent memory, memory mode); kernel 7.0.0-42-generic

settings.server: serve_hy4.py, 56 torch threads, numactl --interleave=all, one request at a time, greedy decoding
settings.compute_dtype: float32 on both arms; the vendor recipe computes in bfloat16
settings.weights: loaded as float32: BF16 values widen exactly; FP8 weights are multiplied by their checkpoint block scales by the library
settings.fp8_input_rounding: where the checkpoint is FP8, inputs of the FP8-scaled matmuls are rounded through FP8 per row and per block of 128 (scale max/448), as the kernels-community/finegrained-fp8 kernels do; no such tensors exist in the BF16 checkpoint
settings.co_tenancy: W02 recorder services on the same processors; arms run one after the other, never together
